timestamps.strategy: Explicit UTC instants are written only when an external action is observed; validators preserve values and never inject the wall clock. Canonical JSON uses sorted keys and UTC Z notation.

self_reference_policy: The state file cannot embed the SHA of the commit that contains itself. GitHub PR metadata and the verification comment may point to the live head but are mutable and do not satisfy immutable readiness evidence. A content-addressed append-only attestation or immutable check artifact must bind the exact final commit; B-006 records that it is unavailable.
